newsitem.title: USA: Watsco to acquire three distributors.
newsitem.headline: Watsco to acquire three distributors.

text.p: Watsco Inc said three of its subsidiaries have signed letters of intent to acquire the net assets and business of three distributors of air conditioning and heating equipment.

Financial terms were not disclosed, but the company said the transactions are expected to be accretive to Watsco's earnings and close within the next 90 days. The deals are subject to reaching definitive agreements and other conditions, it said.

It said that the distributors to be acquired are William Wurzbach Co Inc, of Oakland, Calif.; Kissiah Distributing Co Inc, which operates in the Charlotte-Durham, N.C., area; and Reese Supply Inc, which is based in Jackson, Tenn.

William Wurzbach will add about $18 million in additional annual revenues to Watsco, while Kissiah and its subsidiary, Sousthernair Co Inc will add $5 million, it said. Reese will add about $4 million, it said.
Watsco operates a network of distributors of air conditioning and heating equipment and related products.
